name: Jhipster Forge
description: First dedicated Claude Code plugin for JHipster 8.x. Generate entities, DTOs, JDL domain models, Spring services and controllers directly from Claude Code. Includes 4 auto-activating skills (entity generation, JDL modeling, architectural patterns, microservices/gateway), 6 slash commands, 2 agents (JDL Architect, Forge Reviewer), and a session hook that auto-detects JHipster projects. Opinionated with production-grade patterns: Sealed Interface + Records, Strategy+Registry validation, Collect-Then-Fail, MapStruct polymorphic mapping. Supports JHipster 8.x monolith and microservices/gateway with Keycloak/OAuth2.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills**, **2 agents**, **6 commands** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (4): `architecture-patterns` (Activates when working on a JHipster project that requires applying architectural patterns — including after entity generation, when…), `entity-generation` (Activates when a user wants to generate a JHipster entity, create domain objects, add fields to an existing…), `jdl-modeling` (Activates when a user wants to create or edit a JDL file, model a domain with multiple entities…), `microservices-gateway` (Activates when working on a JHipster microservices architecture — including gateway configuration, inter-service communication, OAuth2/Keycloak setup, service registry,…)
- **Agents** (2): `forge-reviewer` (Forge Reviewer — reviews JHipster-generated code for compliance with architectural patterns (Sealed Interface, Strategy+Registry, Collect-Then-Fail, MapStruct)), `jdl-architect` (JDL Architect — designs complete JHipster domain models from natural language descriptions, generating production-ready JDL files with proper…)
- **Commands** (6): `forge-controller` (Generate a JHipster Spring REST controller (resource) for an existing entity), `forge-entity` (Generate a JHipster entity with fields, relationships, and architectural patterns applied automatically), `forge-jdl` (Create or import a JDL file to generate multiple JHipster entities and relationships at once), `forge-liquibase` (Generate a Liquibase diff changelog after manual database schema changes in a JHipster project), `forge-new` (Scaffold a new JHipster 8.x project interactively — monolith or microservices/gateway), `forge-service` (Generate a JHipster Spring service layer for an existing entity)
- **Hooks** (1): `hooks.json`

Installs with `claude plugin install jhipster-forge@claude-community` from `bngesp/jhipster-forge`.
